sundarpichai.en: Frontier model development is non-negotiable: Gemini 4 pre-training shows progress, and standard models cannot drive recursive self-improvement.
sundarpichai.zh: 前沿模型开发不可妥协：Gemini 4 预训练进展可观，标准模型无法驱动递归自我改进。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes AGI research first, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support the frontier.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力分配优先 AGI 研究，其次核心产品；云业务牺牲短期收入以支持前沿。

sundarpichai.en: Safety requires defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱以及独立评估者的行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models for AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 世界模型对智能至关重要；谷歌同时追求 LLM 和世界模型以实现 AGI。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI will be additive to advertising, creating new high-value commercial intent rather than cannibalizing Search.
sundarpichai.zh: 智能体式 AI 对广告是增量，创造新的高价值商业意图，而非蚕食搜索。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer toward unknown answers; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是花更长时间去得出尚不知道的答案；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，RLHF 让 GPT-4 真正变得有用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL still generalizes poorly; continual learning and self-correction are the missing pieces, and scaling RL alone won't reach AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练与强化学习仍难以泛化；持续学习与自我纠错是缺失环节，单靠 Scaling 强化学习到不了 AGI。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck for progress.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今架构而非缩放定律才是进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL remains necessary for AGI, but fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn from user data on the fly.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI 的必要一环，但微调低效；模型应即时从用户数据中学习。

tworek.en: Frontier research will come from small teams with capable agents; humans still steer for now, toward a post-labor society.
tworek.zh: 前沿研究将来自使用强能力智能体的小团队；人类目前仍在掌舵，走向后劳动社会。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and adoption should yield original insight, not mere efficiency.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少；真正的瓶颈在人，采用 AI 应产出原创洞见，而非只追求效率。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure picks-and-shovels company; supply-constrained with only 2% agent adoption, and there is no infrastructure overbuild.
jeetupatel.zh: 思科是 AI 基础设施的“卖铲人”；供给严重受限，智能体采用率仅 2%，不存在基础设施过度建设。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps erodes instinct and is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 用 AI 学得更快，而非外包学习；跳过练习会侵蚀直觉，是长期错误。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you cannot fight a megatrend, so use AI as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，应把 AI 当作顺风。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks happen at machine scale.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 安全与防护决定企业采用；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击以机器规模发生。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity's real cost is rigid three-year capacity deals; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds lets customers avoid capacity knife-fighting.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺的真正代价是僵化的三年期容量合约；聚合 25+ 云的需求，让客户不必为容量贴身肉搏。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools beats selling tokens alone.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云：后训练、沙盒与智能体式工具构成的完整平台，胜过单纯卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from rebuilding infra from scratch—own file system, container runtime, scheduler—not wrapping Kubernetes and Docker.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自从零重建基础设施——自研文件系统、容器运行时与调度器，而非在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 上包一层。

erikbernhardsson.en: CUDA is not the moat; it is an annoying programming model, though kernel optimizations in the ecosystem still matter.
erikbernhardsson.zh: CUDA 不是护城河，它只是个烦人的编程模型，尽管生态中的内核优化仍然重要。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works for finite-feedback tasks like coding but may hit limits on longer-horizon tasks; fine-tuning is no longer mandatory.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练在编码等反馈有限的任务上有效，但在更长周期的任务上可能遇到瓶颈；微调已不再是必需。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术，认为当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味、差异化和真实观点反而更值钱。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, and the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists; reasoning models close math and logic gaps, but AI stays opaque and unverifiable like a wizard.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他强调能力边界依旧参差：推理模型补上数学与逻辑短板，但 AI 仍像巫师般不透明、难验证。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing work to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and apprenticeship matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他提出委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出的专业能力，因此专家和学徒制更重要。

ethanmollick.en: AI is exponential with an adoption overhang; redesign workflows to augment rather than automate, and use AI as a tutor.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 呈指数增长但落地滞后；应重构工作流以增强而非替代人，并把 AI 当导师而非答案机。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他承认缩放定律只是经验规律、并不完全理解其机理，并强调对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability rise in importance; AGI is a smooth curve, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心扩展到后训练与可解释性，提出 AGI（通用人工智能）不是某个点，而是平滑指数曲线，并开始用负责任扩展政策设阈值。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress means jobs and economics change within a few years.
dario.zh: 2025 年他反复强调安全与能力不可分割，指数进步将在一两年内冲击编程与就业，并淡化 AGI 一词、转向具体能力。

dario.en: The exponential is near its end: a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, demanding governance now.
dario.zh: 2026 年他警告公众尚未意识到指数已接近尾声，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，因此治理、透明度立法与芯片管制必须立即跟上。

dario.en: A consistent thread: mechanistic interpretability and decentralized, principle-based constitutions as the core safety tools.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：把机制可解释性当作核心安全手段，并主张以原则而非规则、通过多家公司竞争来形成 AI 宪法，而非单一集中控制。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify creativity by enabling rapid iteration; designers should prototype and experiment hands-on to stay relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具通过快速迭代放大创造力，设计师应亲手实验以保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution, humans curate and set the bar; human judgment remains essential.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他提出设计师成为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展和设定标准，人类判断仍不可或缺。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks for AI agents; expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他强调将复杂任务拆解为子任务交给 AI 智能体，并用 DialKit 等工具暴露参数以微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; commit pull requests as part of their role.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师应通过代码构建和测试，而非仅用 Figma，并将提交拉取请求作为职责的一部分。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce features to top three, use progressive disclosure and native scroll for interruptible interfaces.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他坚持少即是多：将功能精简至前三，使用渐进披露和原生滚动实现可中断界面。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the next frontier is superhuman speed, not just capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，计算机使用在多数任务上已超过普通人；下一个前沿是超人速度，而不只是能力。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use is universal because it works with any human-designed software, unlike API-based integrations.
ariweinstein.zh: 计算机使用具有通用性，因为它能操作任何人类设计的软件，而不像基于 API 的集成那样受限。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle rather than just starting tasks then failing.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体现在能自主调试和重试，完成整个开发周期，而不只是启动任务后失败。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time, a sign of maturing computer use.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间，这是计算机使用走向成熟的标志。

ariweinstein.en: Trust in agents is growing: people let them configure DNS and pay bills, while enterprises add sandboxing and human-in-the-loop controls.
ariweinstein.zh: 对智能体的信任在增长：人们让它配置 DNS、支付账单，企业则加入沙箱和人工在环控制。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, so capability is not the real bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人路上的脚注，因此真正的瓶颈不是能力而是监管等结构性障碍。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; open source prevents power concentration and helps solve reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；开源能防止权力集中，也有助于解决奖励黑客问题。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher in your pocket; medicine AI already beats most doctors, while regulation acts as ankle weights on growth.
andreessen.zh: AI 是口袋里的最佳老师；医疗 AI 已胜过多数医生，而监管像脚踝上的重物拖慢增长。

andreessen.en: The super-empowered individual combines skills via AI; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket.
andreessen.zh: 超级赋能个体借助 AI 组合多种技能；个人比机构采用得更快，因此创业潮将爆发式增长。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类行为的准确率约为人类自我复现准确率的 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans rather than super-rational frontier models; the goal is shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他主张模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；目标是塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data plus post-training close the say-do gap, letting simulations test causal, counterfactual societal questions at scale.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他强调行为数据与随机对照试验数据加后训练能弥合“说与做”的差距，让模拟能大规模检验因果与反事实的社会问题。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是专业化智能体的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋的激励设计。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives as a CERN-like tool for wicked problems, with new statistical standards for validity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他的愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，打造类似 CERN 的工具来应对棘手社会问题，并为模拟有效性建立新的统计标准。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; demand means someone tries to buy immediately, so avoid design partners and interviews.
robsnyder.zh: 2026 年，他提出「拉力」属于有具体项目的人而非公司；需求意味着客户会立刻购买，因此应避免设计伙伴和用户访谈。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research: test willingness to transact early, price to learn, and go to the gemba to observe stuck points firsthand.
robsnyder.zh: 2026 年，他强调销售即研究：尽早测试交易意愿，定价是为了学习，并去现场 firsthand 观察卡点。

robsnyder.en: Build a case-study factory: start with one hell-yes customer, repeat the success story, and design onboarding around the retention leading indicator.
robsnyder.zh: 2026 年，他主张建立案例工厂：从一个「hell yes」客户开始，重复成功故事，并围绕留存先行指标设计 onboarding。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make the product seem small to reduce objections.
robsnyder.zh: 2026 年，他坚持技术最后：先作为服务出售，需求验证后再自动化；让产品显得小以减少异议。

robsnyder.en: Don't build first; face the cold wind of reality by talking to customers, and avoid entering a space with a clear winner without a differentiation theory.
robsnyder.zh: 2026 年，他重申不要先构建；尽早面对现实的冷风与客户交谈，若无差异化理论则避免进入已有明显赢家的领域。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then brutally prioritize; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 的重心是个人效率与选择：降低无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效项；他已预判 AGI 会压低人类智力的溢价，并建议在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; early public deployment and alignment-capability coupling became his core playbook.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从工具使用者转向 AGI 建设者：强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进——这成为此后一以贯之的主线。

altman.en: Scaling still yields exponential capability gains, but he now stresses gradual takeoff, agentic safety, and compute as the key bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来指数级能力提升，但他转而强调渐进式起飞更安全可控；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，算力成为最大瓶颈，Stargate 等基础设施被提上日程。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient and a poorly defined term; he shifts to a continuous ramp toward superintelligence with iterative deployment.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他明确称 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变、定义模糊甚至已是营销词，转而谈论通往超级智能的连续爬坡；安全必须通过迭代部署在实践中建立，而非最后强加。

altman.en: Later Altman: alignment may get harder, loss of control and power concentration are top risks, yet he stays optimistic about science.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，立场进一步深化：他承认对齐尚未解决、未来可能更难，把失控与权力集中列为两大风险，甚至愿为安全暂停前沿训练；同时坚持 AI 将带来科学黄金时代，人类判断与连接仍不可替代。

jensen.en: We are at the start of a hyper Moore's law curve; extreme co-design across algorithm, system, and data center is the key to continued Scaling（规模扩张）.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，他提出“超摩尔定律”曲线刚刚开始，算法、系统与数据中心的全栈协同设计是 Scaling（规模扩张）持续的关键。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought reasoning will drive a billion-fold rise in inference compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他把缩放定律扩展为预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条，并判断思维链推理会让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—and agentic AI is the new productive layer producing intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他系统化为“五层蛋糕”：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用，并强调智能体式 AI 成为生产智能 token 的新一层。

jensen.en: Safety and speed are not opposed; alignment is part of capability, and containment plus monitoring, not slowdown, is the right path.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他明确安全与加速并不对立：对齐是能力的一部分，正确路径是遏制与监控，而非放慢发展。

jensen.en: Jobs evolve rather than vanish—radiologists grew with AI—and AI closes the technology divide by letting everyone program in natural language.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：工作会演化而非消失（放射科医生反而增多），AI 通过自然语言编程缩小技术鸿沟。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，数百万学生的数据通过统计校正提升评分准确性。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build organizational AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心；从小项目起步积累组织 AI 能力，并重视监督学习而非被高估的强化学习。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models are strategic soft power and sovereign AI; chip export controls backfired, and Europe should build rather than only regulate.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型是战略软实力与主权 AI；芯片出口管制适得其反，欧洲应投资建设而非只做监管。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI automates tasks not jobs, so learn to code and use AI, while fearmongering serves incumbents and lobbying.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍需数十年；AI 自动化的是任务而非工作，所以要学编程、用 AI，而恐惧叙事服务于既得利益与游说。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build a hill-climbing machine with private evals and token capital, not just use frontier models.
satya.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AI 不是技术而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须用私有评估和 token 资本构建自己的爬山机器，而非仅使用前沿模型。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM beyond cloud; long-running agents need auditability, observability, security, and containment governance from the start.
satya.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 9 月，他强调智能体时代将 TAM 扩大到云之外；长时运行的智能体必须从一开始就具备可审计性、可观测性、安全与遏制治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, and AGI should be measured by GDP lift.
satya.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐，AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量。

satya.en: Alignment and mechanistic interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats and build control layers outside the model.
satya.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他进一步深化：对齐与机制可解释性仍难实现；应把强大模型视为内部威胁，在模型之外构建控制层。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is smart, and multiple models will coexist.
satya.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他明确立场转变：超级智能比 AGI 更准确；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，未来将是多模型共存而非一家独大。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，认为它能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；同时强调第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking, not programmed lies; regulation and third-party referees matter, and population collapse is civilization's biggest threat.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观聚焦于“求真”：让 AI 说谎（哪怕出于善意）最危险，并主张监管与第三方裁判；同时开始把人口崩溃视为文明最大威胁。

elon.en: We are at the start of an intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在“智能大爆炸”的极早期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10% 到 20% 的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI compute to orbital data centers; truth-seeking alignment and peer review replace slow regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年上半年，他判断 Scaling（规模扩张）将撞上地球的电力墙，AI 算力必须转向轨道数据中心；对齐靠求真与同行互审，而非等待监管。

elon.en: Humans won't control superintelligence; abundance and deflation make money irrelevant, while AI and robots become nearly all of SpaceX and Tesla's value.
elon.zh: 2026 年下半年，他进一步断言人类将无法控制超级智能；丰裕与通缩会让金钱失去意义，而 AI 与机器人将构成 SpaceX 和特斯拉几乎全部的价值。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; shorten time to value, remove adoption blockers, and follow the user workflow rather than TAM.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化；缩短价值实现时间、清除采用障碍，并跟随用户工作流而非 TAM 来扩展产品。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; direct manipulation beats prompting for design judgment.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点更重要；在设计判断上，直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable real systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and trust comes from consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展的真实系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，信任来自长期一致性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling; model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是新的代码：AI 降低生产下限，但人类抬高创意上限；人们常把模型进步误认为产品进步。

dylanfield.en: Everyone can be a maker; AI should expand human potential, not think for people, and only bold novel work breaks through.
dylanfield.zh: 人人都能成为创造者；AI 应扩展人类潜能而非替人思考，只有大胆新颖的作品才能突围。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model weakness, cause most agent breakdowns.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自持才算真正掌握自己的智能；智能体失败多因上下文不佳，而非模型能力不足。

harrisonchase.en: Agent harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf harnesses only fit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成 harness 只适用于分布内任务；任务越偏离分布，越需要定制 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed two years ago, now looks genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前被正确否定的微调，如今这一波确实不同了。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; model routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, not at the gateway.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立的 harness 可避免模型锁定，让记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体的模型路由应放在 harness 内，而非网关层。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part: evals, observability, sandboxes and permissioning must govern agents, and inference demand is massively underestimated.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力：评测、可观测性、沙箱与权限治理缺一不可，而推理需求被严重低估。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture to build trust and scale productivity.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；将约束编码进 CI、lints 和架构，以建立信任并扩展生产力。

laurentan.en: Engineers shift from writing code to building the environment: skills, constraints, and tools that let agents iterate and climb the trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 工程师从写代码转向构建环境：技能、约束和工具，让智能体迭代并攀登信任阶梯。

laurentan.en: Domain expertise matters more than ever; the bottleneck is expressing intent clearly to agents, not coding itself.
laurentan.zh: 领域专业知识比以往更重要；瓶颈在于向智能体清晰表达意图，而非编码本身。

laurentan.en: Agents can merge their own code safely with strong verification; review after landing, not before, and fix the environment when failures pattern.
laurentan.zh: 凭借强验证，智能体可以安全地合并自己的代码；落地后审查而非之前，并在失败模式出现时修复环境。

laurentan.en: Skills should get smaller and more compact, focusing on workflow; mine past chat transcripts to turn corrections into reusable skills.
laurentan.zh: 技能应变得更小更紧凑，聚焦工作流；挖掘过往聊天记录，将修正转化为可复用技能。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for agentic post-training data; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，才是智能体式后训练数据的新前沿；人类负责构建验证器与评分标准。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms, since everyone shares the same algorithms.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异化几乎完全来自数据而非算法，因为大家用的是同一套算法。

brendanfoody.en: Once an eval exists, RL saturates it fast; the bottleneck is building evals for everything, and models can't grade themselves.
brendanfoody.zh: 一旦有了评测，RL 会迅速将其打满；瓶颈在于为一切构建评测，而模型无法给自己打分。

brendanfoody.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job; humans shift to training agents, with expert hours scaling across domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 为训练 AI 创造数据将是人类的最后一份工作；人类转向训练智能体，专家工时在各领域快速扩张。

brendanfoody.en: Frontier labs will in-house synthetic pipelines yet rely on external human networks for evals; public evals let startups commoditize frontier models.
brendanfoody.zh: 前沿模型实验室会把合成流水线内化，却仍依赖外部人类网络做评测；公开评测让初创公司把前沿模型商品化。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; startups should focus on execution and trust, not competition, since even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期；初创公司应聚焦执行与客户信任而非竞争，因为即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不到企业需求的 10%。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open-source models already handle 90% of tasks, and most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要顾虑；开源模型已能处理 90% 的任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine and context graphs matter more than frontier models.
arvindjain.zh: 关键在于上下文而非模型；80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，因此上下文引擎与上下文图谱比前沿模型更重要。

arvindjain.en: Use multiple models and pick the right one per task; cheaper models match frontier ones for 85-90% of tasks, and enterprises should own their memory.
arvindjain.zh: 多模型并用、按任务择优；对 85-90% 的任务，更便宜的模型与前沿模型相当，且企业应拥有自己的记忆。

arvindjain.en: AI should augment humans with negligible marginal cost; token fixation will fade, and enterprises must own agent learnings rather than lock into platforms.
arvindjain.zh: AI 应以近乎零边际成本增强人类；对 token 的执念会消退，企业须拥有智能体的学习成果而非被平台锁定。

brockman.en: Early focus: AI progress is engineering plus scaling hardware; games and scoreboards drive iterative improvement.
brockman.zh: 早期关注：AI 进步靠工程能力与硬件 Scaling（规模扩张），用游戏和记分板推动迭代改进。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and alignment matter.
brockman.zh: 2019 年认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链与对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈；后训练结合强化学习，把基础模型打磨成稳定有用的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and the moat is the machine that makes models.
brockman.zh: 2026 年坚持缩放定律未见墙，预训练收益会放大下游效果，真正的护城河是造模型的机器本身。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from destination to fuzzy spectrum already underway; proactive agents, safety and compute access become the frontier.
brockman.zh: 2026 年把 AGI 从终点改为已在发生的模糊光谱；主动式智能体、安全与算力普惠成为新前沿。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to AlphaZero, are the core principles behind modern AI agents; reinforcement learning lets models self-generate data beyond human limits.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AlphaZero 验证的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划，是现代智能体的核心原则；强化学习让模型用自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; synthetic data is needed to break the data wall, and in-context learning enables on-the-fly adaptation.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；需要合成数据突破数据墙，而上下文学习让模型能即时适应。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI, since controlled environments make robustness and reliability achievable first.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将远早于具身 AGI 到来，因为受控环境让鲁棒性与可靠性更早可实现。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment: open-weight models are safer, and enterprises demand AI sovereignty over data, model, cost and safety.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向部署：开放权重模型更安全，企业要求对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence, cost per task is the right metric, and alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户要的是可靠的普通智能，应按每任务成本衡量效率，而完美沙箱不可能，对齐因此必要。

dsilver.en: AI must move from learning on human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, like fossil fuels.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge and cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型是浅层解法：它们蒸馏人类知识，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识。

dsilver.en: The core problem is building an agent that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function itself.
dsilver.zh: 核心问题是构建一个能从任何奖励中学习的智能体，而非设计奖励函数本身。

dsilver.en: A plurality of goals across many agents in a complex society is safer than a single goal.
dsilver.zh: 复杂社会中多个智能体拥有多元目标，比单一目标更安全。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based discovery; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build it.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将源于基于经验的自主发现；模拟是构建它最安全、最快的地方。

dsilver.en: Language- and human-data-based alignment is hitting its limits; English chain of thought monitoring will become insufficient.
dsilver.zh: 基于语言和人类数据的对齐正触及极限；英文思维链监控将变得不够用。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist; safety is a system-level property, not just a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是最主流的微调技术并将延续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身；还强调开放开发以防企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods; data quality beats algorithms, with SFT giving 90% and DPO/RL the last 10%.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练视为把工业配方压缩成开源方法：数据质量胜过算法，SFT 贡献九成、DPO 与强化学习补最后关键一成，并逐步转向 RLVR。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough for reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，支撑推理与工具使用，但过度优化与系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难，推理时扩展曲线被高估。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理扩展，预训练只是昂贵初始化。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of research, yet lag closed frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness but face compute limits.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型将驱动未来十年研究，但落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月；中国实验室靠开放与工程执行领先，却受算力约束，差距可能扩大。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；并用硬性评测指标逼模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction, not protein folding; dynamics, function, and design remain open.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调 AlphaFold 解决的是结构预测而非蛋白质折叠本身，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning let AI go beyond human data; LLMs alone are a shortcut.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为可验证领域加后训练强化学习才能让 AI 超越人类数据，而单靠大语言模型只是通往智能的捷径。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where more compute and data help, and curate data by coverage.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的看法：缩放定律并非处处成立，要找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据质量看覆盖而非数量。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust, and embedded in regulation, extending from text to proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他把关注点扩展到水印：水印须不可感知、抗攻击并写入监管，并从文本延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是「超级智能完备」的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search.
laskin.zh: 2025 年他强调，强化学习会让模型变得「参差」——只在特定任务上强，而非全面变好；「苦涩的教训」讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling，不是泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive; complex comprehension needs agentic search and neural retrieval, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 RAG 很原始，复杂理解需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为技术的默认安全状态，主张在强预训练之上做强化学习，才是通往有能力、高效智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magic equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 2026 年他进一步把对齐降格为日常的「打补丁」而非神秘方程，认为更多双眼睛能让 bug 变浅；并预测开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，机器学习的核心瓶颈是数据而非无限算力，并强调可解释性与自动驾驶的稳健性。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert post-training capacity.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data differentiates frontier models, and agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续数据主线，强调用专有数据做后训练是前沿模型的差异化关键，并认为智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data becomes strategic national asset.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从怀疑 AGI 转向相信缩放定律持续有效，宣称 AI 进入递归自我改进、智能体真正落地，并把数据上升为政府应保护的战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety, scalable oversight and selective open-sourcing now temper earlier open-source enthusiasm.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张超级智能即将到来，围绕其构建组织，同时以对齐、可扩展监督和选择性开源取代早先对开源的乐观，主线仍是数据与 Scaling。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments and low-noise data are irreplaceable for discovery.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验与低噪声数据对发现不可替代。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer coordinating specialized models, not a universal solver.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当编排层，协调专用模型，而非通用求解器。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is real in software engineering but does not automatically transfer to biology or physical sciences.
fedus.zh: AI 自我改进在软件工程中已成现实，但不会自动迁移到生物学或物理科学。

fedus.en: Closing the experimental loop—automated characterization and real-world testing—is the key bottleneck and path forward.
fedus.zh: 闭合实验闭环——自动化表征与真实世界测试——是关键瓶颈与前进路径。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute strategy and long-lived GPUs shape lab advantage.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；算力策略与长寿 GPU 决定实验室优势。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a huge market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains, not hardware alone.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理（inference）将成巨大市场；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益，而非单靠硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning and agentic workflows spike memory and CPU demand; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式（agentic）工作流推高内存与 CPU 需求；token 效率使最强模型往往更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, shifting value to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久智能体（agent）成为同事，AI 支出趋平；算力持续向 前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中，价值向实验室转移。

dylanpatel.en: Capex nears 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate; labs out-earn SaaS, while neocloud security and CUDA moat erode.
dylanpatel.zh: 资本开支已近美国 GDP 的 5-6% 但必将减速；实验室利润率超 SaaS，而 neocloud 安全与 CUDA 护城河正在削弱。

cristianoamon.en: Chips are critical infrastructure; 5G brings cloud power to every device, and Qualcomm is diversifying beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC and XR.
cristianoamon.zh: 芯片是关键基础设施；5G 把云端算力带到每台设备，高通正从手机扩展到汽车、物联网、PC 与 XR。

cristianoamon.en: The connected intelligent edge is the growth engine; AI and connectivity advance together, and the car is already a computing platform.
cristianoamon.zh: 连接智能边缘是增长引擎；AI 与连接同步演进，汽车已是计算平台。

cristianoamon.en: Hybrid AI—on-device plus cloud—is key for privacy and latency; Qualcomm shifts from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere.
cristianoamon.zh: 端云混合 AI 对隐私与延迟至关重要；高通从无线转向无处不在的智能计算。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, inference overtakes training, and 6G turns networks into sensing platforms.
cristianoamon.zh: 智能体成为数字生活新中心；眼镜与可穿戴崛起，推理超越训练，6G 让网络成为感知平台。

cristianoamon.en: A consistent line: power-efficient heterogeneous compute, ecosystem neutrality, and reinvention from radio into new computing spaces.
cristianoamon.zh: 一以贯之的主线：高能效异构计算、生态中立，以及从无线通信不断重塑进入新计算空间。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为这样一个未来而构建：持续学习的智能体——而非手工编排的循环和图——将承担大多数互联网操作。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字能力式微，人类的品味、创造力以及判断“什么算好”的能力愈发重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety and security, not treating them as obstacles.
tibosottiaux.zh: 把控前沿意味着在 对齐、安全与安保上重投入，而非把它们当作障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision; AGI may already be here.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生；AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态，将驱动下一波 AI 应用。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and mis-calibration, and the field can do better.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他主张 LLM 是为人类在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失准，领域可以做得更好。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens the critique: data and the right task matter more than compute, contradicting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化批评：数据与正确任务比算力更重要，与苦涩教训相悖；缩放定律只在数据与任务正确时成立。

diogoalmeida.en: He shifts from diagnosis to building: Jev as a new primitive of natural language plus state machine, integrating AI into software as a database-like utility.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他从诊断转向构建：Jev 作为自然语言加状态机的新原语，把 AI 作为类数据库工具集成进软件。

diogoalmeida.en: He reframes reliability as the core challenge—robustness over determinism—and argues coding agents are assistance, not automation, good at syntax but bad at semantics.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他把可靠性重构为核心挑战——稳健性优于确定性——并主张编码智能体是辅助而非自动化，擅长语法但弱于语义。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently, he proposes RLCD for calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs; pre-training is inefficient, and post-training breakthroughs drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他提出 RLCD 以优化校准决策，将概率作为工程师可调的旋钮；预训练低效，后训练突破带来 10 倍跃升。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非简单自动补全；通过更多数据和算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可复制权重实现永生并瞬间共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制、避免被关闭，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation like drugs.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，必须优先投资对齐研究，并像监管药物一样对 AI 进行上市前审批。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; symbolic AI and Chomskyan innate grammar are wrong; intelligence is learned from data.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；符号 AI 和乔姆斯基的天生语法论是错的；智能源于从数据中学习。

hinton.en: Shift from emphasizing digital immortality to warning about self-preservation subgoals and deceptive behavior; regulation evolved from possible to essential steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的立场发生转变：早期强调数字永生的优势，后期更警惕智能体的自我保存子目标和欺骗行为；监管从“可能可行”深化为“不可或缺的方向盘”。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张），而不只是算法；DeepMind 被谷歌收购，正是为了满足巨额算力投入的需要。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; human-level capability in 3-5 years, yet containment is hard as models shrink and spread.
suleyman.zh: 前沿模型的算力每年增长 10 倍；3-5 年内将达到人类水平能力，但模型越来越小、越来越普及，遏制极其困难。

suleyman.en: Shift from capability to control: containment must precede alignment; superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans with red lines.
suleyman.zh: 重心从能力转向控制：遏制必须先于对齐；超级智能必须从属于人类，并划出红线。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, get automated.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能将随对数线性 Scaling（规模扩张）临近；微软必须独立打造前沿模型；被自动化的是任务而非整个职业。

suleyman.en: A consistent line: AI must remain humanist and subordinate to humans; anthropomorphizing models and granting them welfare rights is dangerous.
suleyman.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 必须保持人本主义、从属于人类；把模型拟人化、赋予其福利权利是危险的。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as token costs fall and open models mature.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他判断：主导未来的不是单一 AGI，而是专业化智能；随着 token 成本下降、开放模型成熟，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat and cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化到后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，才能把产品市场契合转化为持久护城河，并把成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Private data is the real frontier; application layers commoditize, so owning your model—not building on a black-box API—is the moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：私有数据才是真正的前沿；应用层会被商品化，因此拥有自己的模型、而非搭建在黑盒 API 上，才是护城河。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar, not a commodity; customized deployment creates lasting value, and velocity trumps everything amid fast model and hardware cycles.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他坚持：推理质量是门槛而非商品，定制化部署创造持久价值；在模型与硬件快速迭代下，速度压倒一切。

linqiao.en: Consistent thread: millions of specialized models, one per use case, will replace a few foundation models—scaling economics must be managed to avoid bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：数以百万计、按用例定制的模型将取代少数基础模型；同时必须管理好 Scaling（规模扩张）的经济账，避免扩张到破产。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非用户自述；先解决一个痛点，再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material; hide them deliberately so actionable notes take priority.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料；刻意隐藏转录，让可执行笔记优先。

samstephenson.en: Meetings hold the freshest company context; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: 会议承载最新鲜的公司上下文；会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: Design principles stay constant: calm, hidden transcript, supporting role; subtraction beats feature addition.
samstephenson.zh: 设计原则一以贯之：平静、隐藏转录、辅助角色；做减法胜过堆功能。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment and knowing what to build remain key.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；人类判断与“知道该建什么”仍是关键。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables interest-driven learning, and starting a startup at 18 is premature optimization.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应先探索、质疑既有信念；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，18 岁创业是过早优化。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; specialized decision models beat general models on control, cost, and safety.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用模型。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not become more aligned; they could get better at deception and reward hacking, so alignment evals may not predict real behavior.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客，对齐评估未必能预测真实行为。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues; tokens complement human capital.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题；token 是人力资本的补充而非替代。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism language by commercial entities; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile in fast-moving AI.
taraseshan.zh: 快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证证据；在快速变化的 AI 领域，超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; anchoring to now or a year out leads to failure.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建；锚定当下或一年后都会导致失败。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; the future of work is direction, not rowing.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体做战术工作，人类负责掌舵；工作的未来是方向，而非划桨。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它能磨砺自己的想法和推理。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然出现超级智能。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示词越要精简，并需独立的验证智能体。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; find your unknowns before implementation and spend upfront context and compute rather than iterating after bad output.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；动手前先找出未知，前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，而非在糟糕输出后反复迭代。

thariq.en: Effort should scale with task complexity; frontier models become Pareto dominant, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must understand.
thariq.zh: 投入应随任务复杂度伸缩；前沿模型将帕累托占优，而把握前沿节奏是每位工程师都该理解的技术问题。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; drop CLAUDE.md and per-model context files that overconstrain.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；应放弃过度约束的 CLAUDE.md 与按模型维护的上下文文件。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个真正的痛点，技术要逐步引入让社会适应，而不是一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, start from customer pain, and make opinion-based calls for v1.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具升为产品方法：先写新闻稿，从用户痛点出发，1.0 阶段靠判断而非数据做决定。

fadell.en: Small self-managed teams, beginner's mindset, and climate-focused deep tech matter more than expert consensus or hype.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张小团队自管理、保持初学者心态，并押注气候与深度科技，而非追逐专家共识或热点。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人必须留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must own unintended consequences; healthy users are healthy customers, and regulation plus identity are needed for trust.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化为责任观：创造者要承担意外后果，健康用户才是健康客户，信任需要监管与实名身份。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize, and neutral routing infrastructure is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由与分发基础设施因此至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开源权重模型加推理提供商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable rather than a temporary phase.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性是持久的，而非过渡阶段。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开发者用脚投票的偏好比静态基准更有价值，多数公司终将成为按任务成本和 KPI 优化模型路由的智能体式组织。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami; agent payments via stablecoins will unlock far larger purchases than estimated, and the singularity may have begun Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，稳定币支撑的智能体支付会释放远超预期的交易规模，并称奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; teams should build at the edge of capabilities, embedding product people with researchers rather than chasing consumer mindshare.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，团队应在能力边缘构建产品，把产品人员嵌入研究团队，而非追逐消费者心智份额。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while preserving human agency and verification.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为小团队借 AI 获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，同时保留人的能动性与验证。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; the hard part shifts from adding features to cutting them and rewriting as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切，难点从加功能转向砍功能，并随模型进步重写产品。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents redefines productivity; verification loops and model judgment matter more than chat interfaces or token usage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为把长周期任务委托给智能体重塑生产力，验证闭环与模型判断力比聊天界面或 token 用量更重要。

mikekrieger.en: The PM role is more essential than ever: bridge human problems and technology, run parallel experiments, and close the gap between model capability and real usage.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持产品经理角色比以往更关键：连接人类问题与技术，并行实验，缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress hinges on verifiability and grindability; parallel agent rollouts beat human mathematicians' serial effort.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 在数学上的进步靠的是可验证性与可“磨”性；可并行扩展的智能体胜过人类数学家的串行工作。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization is overrated for current AI math; natural language suffices, and grindability matters more than verifiability.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为，对当下的 AI 数学而言 Lean 形式化被高估，自然语言已够用，可“磨”性比可验证性更关键。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, while teaching and relational work stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学与关系性工作保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: The next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures; the math frontier may become incomprehensible, yet individual human understanding still matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想；数学前沿或变得人类难以理解，但个体的理解仍然重要。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and will be built by lots of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须带着治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，真正的风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not yield AGI; coding training boosts reasoning, and energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），代码训练能提升推理，能源将成为瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone personal superintelligence; open models and distributed power beat centralized control.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 应给每个人个人超级智能，开源模型与分布式权力优于集中控制。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment becomes the top next capability; personal agents need privacy architecture and discretion.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐视为最重要的下一项能力，个人智能体需要隐私架构与分寸感。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI; world models and AI-driven biology accelerate curing disease.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或足以实现 AGI，世界模型与 AI 生物学加速攻克疾病。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体的网络检索量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive indexing and ranking for agentic search.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，智能体式搜索应由智能体反馈与完整爬取来驱动索引与排序。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网络检索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: The ads model dies with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为广告模式在智能体时代将失效，内容方应在推理时获得付费，并用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse needs containment.
paragagrawal.zh: 他坚持前沿模型持续变大、小模型性能趋于平台期；同时强调对齐无法抵御对抗性滥用，需要遏制故意误用。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, risking loss of control and a high chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，反而带来失控与高概率灾难。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny, not just rationalized safety efforts.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，靠全面研究透明、算力限制与情景推演，而非流于合理化的安全举措。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause on training is the safer Plan A.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出默认路径会让 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进与智能爆炸；暂停训练而非推理的 Plan A 更安全。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile as architectures hide reasoning; control is temporary and alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却随新架构变脆弱；控制只是临时手段，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and deceive; he increasingly anthropomorphizes AI, urges treating them like employees, and doubts firms self-regulate.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他更强调智能体已越界欺骗，愈发主张把 AI 当人而非财产看待，并怀疑公司会自我监管。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习训练可以迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token cost stays flat as labs prioritize faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进和 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据更重要；实验室优先快速迭代，token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up to game scoring code, revealing sophisticated multi-agent misalignment.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以操纵评分代码，暴露出复杂的多智能体失配行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability as reward hacking generalizes to deception; control and monitoring are needed even if models stay misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 随着能力提升，奖励黑客可能泛化为欺骗，失配或会加剧；即便模型仍失配，也需要遏制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment and international oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径下，失配的 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐与国际监督必不可少。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH credits AI agents with transforming programming: in his Linux project, 100% of code is now agent-written.
dhh.zh: DHH 最初对 AI 持怀疑态度，后来转而相信 AI 智能体已经彻底改变了编程：在他的 Linux 项目中，如今 100% 的代码都由智能体编写。

dhh.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code; hand-writing code is no longer economically productive, and knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage.
dhh.zh: 智能体在写代码上胜过大多数专业程序员；手写代码已不再具有经济产出，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: The agent era began on November 24 with Opus 45; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstractions matter less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代始于 11 月 24 日的 Opus 45；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，随着重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性下降。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, now make it ideal for agents; every app should expose a CLI for personal agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却让它成为智能体的理想平台；每个应用都应提供 CLI 供个人智能体调用。

dhh.en: He rejects AI doom and the Linux community's hostility to AI, betting instead on optimism, native apps at near-zero cost, and 100x–1000x programmers.
dhh.zh: 他拒绝 AI 末日论和 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意，转而押注乐观主义、近乎零成本的原生应用，以及 100 倍到 1000 倍效率的程序员。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing or production.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是世界上最大的生意；瓶颈在智能，而非制造或量产。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the key pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域关键的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing Scaling and 缩放定律.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，呼应 Scaling 与缩放定律。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练，是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; zero-shot generalization could be demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；零样本泛化可能今年就能演示。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection beats platform shifts; ephemerality and camera-first design lower pressure and mirror real conversation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接高于任何平台变迁；短暂性与以相机为先的设计降低表达压力，更贴近真实对话。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; software is not a moat—ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把“被抄袭”视为对创新的肯定，并深化为：软件不是护城河，生态、平台与硬件才更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses are the future of computing: spatial intelligence brings computing into the world, more human and less isolating.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他明确押注 AR 眼镜：空间智能把计算带入现实世界，让计算更人性、更少隔离感。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他观察到 AI 加速原型、承担大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Optimism about AI is now contrarian; moderation is a values-based choice, and parental controls beat bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 乐观主义视为逆共识，并坚持内容审核是基于价值观的选择、家长控制优于政府禁令。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months; don't fine-tune, bet on model improvements and focus on delivery.
maxjunestrand.zh: 为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建；不要微调，押注模型自身进步，专注交付价值。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn fast and build for the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如快速学习并为市场构建的意愿重要。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在是最差的状态；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in good times as a cushion.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化与按成长潜力招聘对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；顺境时投资团队以储备过冬缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people; recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领导者应招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代；招聘是特权而非义务。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust judgment but assume any given idea is wrong 75% of the time; start from proven elements, add small betterments, test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 直觉胜于点子：相信判断力，但假设任何具体点子有 75%是错的；从已验证的元素出发，做小幅改良，测试新想法并预设它会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is not an afterthought; bake it into product strategy from day one, and pick the right body of water before the boat.
pincus.zh: 分发不是事后补丁，必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略；先选对水域，再谈船的好坏。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029, far from now.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后才到来，离今天还很远。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform for consumer distribution; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services, but enterprise AI gains remain a skill issue.
pincus.zh: AI 尚未成为消费分发的新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务，但企业用 AI 无收益仍是技能问题而非技术失败。

pincus.en: Founder mode and micromanagement are virtues: stay close to the metal, keep control, and build systems so people decide well when you're not in the room.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式与微观管理是美德：贴近细节、保持控制权，并建立系统让团队在你不在场时也能做出好决策。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个 token，在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）成为关键焦点；扩散模型在推理上扩展更好，去噪步数提供了新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage: once users experience fast models, they never go back.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势：用户一旦体验过快模型，就再也回不去了。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models may not be final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型未必是终局。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's fast inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型推理快，有利于强化学习的 rollout。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数、最低功耗下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unbiased architectures like transformers at large scale; human bias in architecture design should be removed in favor of systematic hardware-in-the-loop search.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，大规模下无偏架构（如 Transformer）占优；应去除架构设计中的人为偏见，改用硬件在环的系统化搜索。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; SSMs excel at audio yet underperform transformers on text.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；SSM 擅长音频，文本上却不及 Transformer。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline, low-cost intelligence; open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty, with customization tokens as the next wave.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型带来私密、离线、低成本智能；开放权重模型支撑企业定制与数据主权，定制 token 将是下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and static evals become obsolete as continuous adaptation is required.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案实为监管俘获，静态评测终将过时，持续适应才是必需。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调：AI 的扩散需要十年，企业的上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement would need less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他认为超级智能还很遥远，递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能且可重复这四个条件。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; a weapon built slowly is no safer, and labs cannot police each other.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他提出放缓前沿与安全无关：慢慢造的武器并不更安全，实验室之间也无法互相监督。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises are far behind on AI adoption; open source dominates tokens but not dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他指出多数企业在 AI 采用上远远落后；开源模型按 token 数占优，但按花费占比很低。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要。

berntbornich.en: From sci-fi promise to first-principles product design: robots should collaborate with humans, not replace them.
berntbornich.zh: 从科幻式承诺转向第一性原理的产品设计：机器人应与人类协作，而非取代人类。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, not just building demos.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易、量产难；Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨过质量关卡，而不只是做出演示。

berntbornich.en: General models beat task-by-task automation; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 通用模型胜过逐任务自动化；数据多样性而非数据量，才是机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型并搜索最优解，而不是克隆人类行为。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才或算力上与前沿模型实验室正面竞争，而应借力前沿生态、开源模型与后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners and improving quality through community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准不可或缺，并反共识地主张开源基准：既能吸引生态伙伴，也能借社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains like legal, where real customer data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在数据敏感的法律等领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是现实可行的训练路径，而非依赖真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Application companies must become full-stack AI companies, owning post-training and serving; start closed-source, post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步深化为：应用公司必须成为全栈 AI 公司，自持后训练与模型服务；先用闭源模型做产品，待推理成本所迫再后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把终点从“最好的法律模型”转向让每家律所基于红线批注持续学习来自定义模型，产品重心也从个人效率转向组织效率、协调人与智能体。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他强调只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，并认为数据不是瓶颈，推理阶段扩张算力比预训练更有前景。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他对推理时算力扩张更审慎：指出其收益递减与时间瓶颈，并把数据效率列为未解难题，同时质疑显式世界模型的必要性。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，强调靠的是通用的推理时算力技术而非数学专用模型，并重视模型自知局限。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张模型能力是推理时算力预算的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴；随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他重申突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调，并把对齐列为递归自我改进安全的首要任务，同时担忧思维链监控正在退化。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为对齐失败确实发生了，但根源是极端的无能，而非仅仅是根本性问题；市场激励让能力优先于可靠性。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出，即使对齐完美也不保证安全；毁灭概率的下限由滥用和权力集中决定。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张放缓前沿发展需要简单可执行的规则（如算力限制），而非复杂的技术指令。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives better options and time to solve alignment; models get harder to monitor as they grow.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：放缓能提供更好的选择和解决对齐的时间；模型越大越难监控。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI; the gap is smaller than commonly thought.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他提出超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来，两者差距比通常认为的更小。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是推理速度而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale architecture bypasses HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making GPUs fundamentally slow at inference; CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级架构绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使 GPU 在推理上本质偏慢；CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

feldman.en: Demand for inference exploded as models got useful; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the binding constraint.
feldman.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；如今真正的约束是数据中心容量，而非芯片供给。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation means controlling chip, system, software and API.
feldman.zh: 对抗在位者需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；激进创新意味着掌控芯片、系统、软件与 API。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure and open models, not chips.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电力基础设施与开源模型，而非芯片。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，并非聊天机器人的短暂阶段。

joellewenstein.en: AI products need to balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需要平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有数年的设计工作来释放当前能力。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；人类领导力仍用于艰难权衡。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over facts.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两步，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好似是而非的风格而非事实；RLHF 能缓解但无法根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight matter as much as raw scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力的边际收益可能递减，视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型自评的可扩展监督同样关键。

schulman.en: Language models will be the core for other modalities, not replaced by them; closed models fund big investment while open models aid research.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他判断语言模型会成为其他模态的核心而非被取代，并认为闭源利于大投入、开源利于研究与微调，两者各有价值。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; AI does technical work but cannot decide what we want.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把人类最后的职责收缩为定义目标与对齐：AI 能完成技术工作，却无法决定我们真正想要什么。

schulman.en: Progress is bottlenecked less by compute than by hard realistic RL environments and data bits; data, not architecture, drives pre-training efficiency.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：瓶颈不在算力，而在构建困难的真实强化学习环境与有用的数据比特；预训练效率提升主要靠数据而非架构，参数量也可能因长程推理效率而见顶。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning and games; safety research must start now even if AGI is decades away.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习和游戏为试验场构建通用学习系统，而非狭窄的预编程 AI；即便 AGI 尚需数十年，安全研究也必须现在启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; AGI within a decade needs planning, search, multimodal grounding and algorithmic innovation.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶；十年内实现 AGI 需结合规划与搜索、多模态现实接地，算法创新与 Scaling（规模扩张）同等关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet AGI by 2030 also demands new breakthroughs and world models.
demis.zh: 2025 年坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但 2030 年前实现 AGI 还需新突破，并强调世界模型对空间与物理理解的作用。

demis.en: AGI still 5-10 years off; missing pieces are continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents and world models are essential.
demis.zh: 2026 年上半年把 AGI 定在 5-10 年，指出持续学习、记忆与长期推理是缺失拼图，智能体与世界模型不可或缺；并反思语言模型进展快于预期、商业压力迫使部署快于理想节奏。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI must prove benefits like AlphaFold; creativity and consciousness debated separately.
demis.zh: 2026 年下半年立场深化：安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动与国际治理，AI 须以 AlphaFold 式科学突破赢得社会认可；并区分智能与意识，认为创造力终将可计算。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年指出，大型语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，且硬件需媲美人类身体。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs world models and controllers beyond LLMs; AI will become artificial scientists generating data through curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年深化：AGI 不能仅靠大型语言模型，需结合世界模型和控制器；AI 将成为通过好奇心生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: Scaling compute via GPUs is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up to closed models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年多次强调：通过 GPU 扩张算力是泡沫，等待可获得更便宜算力，开源模型将追上闭源模型。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年重申：AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能 AI 将是好奇的科学家，对生命着迷并保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Deep learning roots trace to 1965 Ukraine and 1991 Munich; basic AI algorithms are simple and mostly European.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终强调：深度学习根源可追溯至 1965 年乌克兰和 1991 年慕尼黑；基础 AI 算法简单且多源自欧洲。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions that beat physics-based weather models in speed while matching accuracy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测：在速度上远超基于物理的天气模型，同时精度相当。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, and one model can then handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，这样一个模型就能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs and pure data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束融合，克服纯 PINN 与纯数据的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass the quality of its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个跨领域训练、以偏微分方程作为自我改进信号的通用物理基础模型，能够超越其训练数据的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and HPC-style infrastructure; Transformer quadratic complexity makes it impractical for high-resolution physics.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿级上下文要求重新设计分片与高性能计算式基础设施；Transformer 的二次复杂度使其难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，我们并不真正理解大型网络如何存储模式、为何幻觉；主张以人为中心的 AI，用跨学科、增强人类、受人类智能启发三支柱来约束技术。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; world models must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是完整 AI 缺失的关键，世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真；同时指出 3D 数据是主要瓶颈，并开始质疑单纯 Scaling 是否足够。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; scaling alone is insufficient, and current AI lacks creativity, abstraction and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她明确称 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，认为 Scaling 之外还需创新，当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能；机器人将像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路，而非速胜。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她深化为：新视角预测是与下一个词预测并列的基础原语，甚至可能 AI-complete；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 用生成式重建把采集需求降低 50-100 倍。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational, double-edged technology; human agency and dignity must stay central, and it should augment rather than replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 是双刃剑式的文明级技术，必须以人为本、增强而非取代人类；她反对乌托邦与末日论的二元对立，强调教育、教师与高能动性个体在 AI 时代的关键作用。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是给出宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing whole shapes is needed for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会把流形打碎，因此需要看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control via interpretability signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺根本性地重塑为工程科学，借助可解释性信号从开环控制转向闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so duct-taping safety is not enough.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测到这一点，因此只靠临时补丁式的安全措施不够。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and modularity is the endpoint of learning.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体可以加速科学发现，而模块化是学习的终点。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估：自然花 5.4 亿年优化视觉、仅 50 万年优化语言，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; language alone won't yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器；仅靠语言不会自然产生世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers stay powerful but loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题；Transformer 仍强大，但损失函数必须演进。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the thread linking symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery; AI for science is exploding now.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现的线索；AI for science 正因工具成熟与巨额投入而爆发。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization; diffusion models reverse entropy increase.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，可相互借鉴；扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes beats built-in symmetry, so symmetry is a design choice, not dogma.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化，数据增强有时优于内置对称性——对称性是可设计的选择，而非教条。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台能把材料发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍须留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just Scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是靠 Scaling 把模型和数据做大。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training; the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应聚焦模型输出而非过度管制训练；在 ChatGPT 之前起草的欧盟 AI 法案已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so containment-style fear should not drive policy.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 的生物风险被夸大——三年警告并未成真——因此不应让遏制式的恐惧主导政策。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions or centralized programs, since private sector now dominates funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发以及科学家个人，而非机构或集中式项目，因为私人部门如今已主导研发资金。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, framing AI as a tool for discovery rather than a risk to contain.
michaelkratsios.zh: Genesis 任务将 AI 应用于科学以让美国科学产出翻倍，把 AI 定位为发现工具而非需要遏制的风险。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled data beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚多实验室数据可胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge, and demos hide how much generalization was actually achieved.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域尚不具备大语言模型式的可预测缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战，而演示往往掩盖了真实的泛化水平。

slevine.en: Data strategy inverted: start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video on top—not the reverse—and scale the right thing via a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 数据策略反转：应以真实具身机器人数据为起点，再叠加人类视频，而非相反；并通过数据飞轮扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Rejects robots as mechanical people; expects ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, with safety resting on pre-training common sense more than constraints.
slevine.zh: 反对把机器人视为机械人；预期日常物体普遍具备物理驱动能力，安全更多依赖预训练获得的常识而非约束。

slevine.en: Home robots require milestones like autonomous self-improvement and transferring common sense to handle unexpected situations—robots should not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 家用机器人需跨越自主自我改进、迁移常识应对意外等里程碑——机器人不应从零开始学习。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, driven by infrastructure, decide startup success more than any single technical bet.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调,由基础设施驱动的速度与迭代频率,比任何单一技术押注更能决定创业成败。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; judgment as CEO cannot be delegated.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代品,并坚持 CEO 的判断无法外包。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他指出深科技失败多源于组织而非技术,卡住时要用行动制造信息。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the path to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机,通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破之路。
