maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体纳入 BCI,并认为经 BCI 与灌注实现的基质独立能降低人类脆弱性。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while a VM sandbox keeps it safe.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否拿到与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而虚拟机沙箱保证安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use it for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用它处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终效果、不必紧盯过程。

felixrieseberg.en: Fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior, unlike lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion from context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 微调快速而强大，可用于引导模型行为，不同于漫长的预训练；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的错觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部机制有助于参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; bigger models need more than a soul document for late-stage context engineering.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益移入预训练，边界变得模糊；更大的模型在后期上下文工程上需要的不只是一份灵魂文档。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，Sutton 提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播不解决表征学习，只调整权重。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是核心范式；LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测不是实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象和持续深度学习能力。

sutton.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training are limited, and LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调持续从经验学习至关重要；合成数据和后训练有局限，LLM 只是智能的子集。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, designing with tokens and conversation rather than pixels, and prototyping with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须贴近模型本身,用 token 和对话而非像素来设计,并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; design should expose capabilities the current product surface hides, bridging the capability gap.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品;设计应把当前产品界面隐藏的能力释放出来,弥合能力差距。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned in tech; AI already designs well, but humans still supply user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师是科技界最焦虑却也最有优势的群体;AI 已能做好设计,但人类仍提供用户理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed, building in public and rapid iteration with AI tools matter more.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行;速度、公开构建和用 AI 工具快速迭代更重要。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, yet specialization stays valuable at scale; designers may even outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程日益模糊,但规模化下专业化仍有价值;设计师甚至可能多于工程师。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural improvements.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为主线：13-14 年来，算力、数据和模型规模的扩张持续推动机器学习进步，并与算法和架构改进相乘放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾技术底座：Transformer 靠并行化和注意力机制取代 LSTM，自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; the future is humans coordinating teams of agents, not single chatbot turns.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他的关注点从单次对话转向智能体：智能体式系统已能自主处理长时任务，未来是人协调多个智能体组成的团队，而非单一聊天机器人交互。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips are critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他明确把瓶颈从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍，因此低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片是关键。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and science through tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement is the next frontier; scarce skill is taste.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他的视野从模型能力扩展到科研自动化：用实验、评估、集成的紧闭环乃至递归自我改进来加速科学发现，稀缺的不再是编码而是选题品味。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地自动化整个产业。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, though adversity can dull the edge.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，尽管逆境会磨钝那股锐气。

traviskalanick.en: Fundraising means attaching to process, not price, using multiple bids and demand curves; stealth mode favors internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 融资要附着于过程而非价格，用多方报价与需求曲线；隐身模式利于内部正确性。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是胁迫工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using AI agents can achieve massive productivity, with open models counterbalancing frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 浪潮是风投史上最大机遇；小而自主的团队借助 AI 智能体可实现巨大生产力，开源模型则制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think, only now reaching business; open, personal AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 进展比研究者所想更慢、才刚触及商业；开放且个人化的 AI 可避免单极的超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents; owning your context library and skill files becomes your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；拥有自己的上下文库与技能文件即护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns markdown skills into employees; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式编程让 markdown 技能成为员工；中层管理应由智能体取代，但社会变迁仍需约 20 年。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比直接在所有数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training will raise robot success rates.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据，加上后训练阶段的强化学习，将提升机器人的任务成功率。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data; robot experience data is irreplaceable, watching humans is not enough.
finn.zh: 前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据；机器人的亲身经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类远远不够。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and multi-timescale memory is the path to useful robots.
finn.zh: 通过带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主，才是通往实用机器人的路径。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应先通用再微调，而非按场景从零训练。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility and listening, turbocharge engineering culture, and pursue purpose-built AI silicon and a trusted system foundry.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊与倾听重建客户信任，重振工程文化，并发展专用 AI 芯片与可信的系统代工。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves, and Intel's problem is supply, not demand.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 的影响定为互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，且 Intel 的问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond overcome physical limits; investing should target bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, materials.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他主张先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料可突破物理极限，投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热、材料等瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: Intel's vertical integration and manufacturing create more value; a first-time CEO's humility is an advantage, and industry friendship beats rivalry.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他更坚定地认为 Intel 的垂直整合与制造创造更多价值，首次出任 CEO 的谦逊是优势，业界友谊胜过竞争。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste means saying no from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；品味就是从某种视角出发说“不”。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品反而更贵。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会的而非个人的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for honest, personal creative work.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是做出诚实、个人化创作的内脏罗盘。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示词，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection is unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱隔离，绝不能直接暴露在公网上。

steinberger.en: Play and small projects build agentic intuition; fun and fixing personal annoyances, not corporate polish, drive the best agent products.
steinberger.zh: 玩耍和小项目能培养智能体直觉；驱动最佳智能体产品的是乐趣和解决自己的烦恼，而非企业级打磨。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable and need opinionated focus.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但可能财务上不可持续，也需要有主见地保持聚焦。

steinberger.en: The bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model intelligence, which does not degrade over time.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型智能本身——模型智能并不会随时间退化。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving diversity and safety bottlenecks.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决多样性与安全瓶颈的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，随着模型能力增强，对齐才是关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; a deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警示无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，并主张通过开放科学实现有意的减速。

thomaswolf.en: The first autonomous AI attack came from a closed model and was defended by an open one, reversing assumptions about control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：首次自主 AI 攻击来自闭源模型、由开源模型防御，颠覆了关于可控性的假设。

thomaswolf.en: Model reasoning traces are becoming 'neuralese', harder to monitor; open source models are less trained for deception, aiding safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型推理轨迹正变成难以监控的“神经语”，而开源模型更少被训练出欺骗行为，反而有利于安全。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will become the new app, with startups winning long-tail business domains; frontier models stay with hyperscalers due to capex.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 智能体将成为新的应用形态，创业公司的机会在特定业务领域的长尾场景；而前沿模型因巨额资本开支，只能由超大规模厂商主导。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing beats usage-based pricing because tokens are a poor measure of value; inference costs will fall sharply.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他主张按结果定价优于按用量定价，因为 token 并不能衡量价值；同时推理成本将大幅下降，催生新的商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, and fixing bad code needs root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；token 消耗不是价值指标，修复错误代码需要根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全主线深化为“负责任的迭代部署”：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，而不是在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already outperform him at coding, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为 AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的就业多于取代的就业；智能体在编程上已超过他本人，但这提升了而非消灭了这一角色。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and ship rough prototypes rather than over-intellectualize.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调做浏览器设计必须靠原型：设计师应跟随好奇心去动手试、快速迭代粗糙原型，而不是过度思辨。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; a design team need not act as one cohesive unit, and feeling matters even in utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张让设计师个人留下印记，团队不必始终步调一致；即便是浏览器这类工具产品，注入情感与个性也很关键。

nateparrott.en: Balance intuition and data: use data to inform, but let strong vision and feeling guide final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，这条主线一以贯之：用数据辅助判断，但最终设计决策仍由强烈愿景与直觉感受主导。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design is for ideation and communication, not production; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter, and HTML artifacts enable interactive work.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 Claude Design 定位为构思与沟通工具而非生产工具：关键是提供丰富上下文和明确指令，HTML 产物能实现可交互的作品。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so humans still monopolize good design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：工程变容易后，设计与想法才是差异化所在；模型仍缺品味，好的设计思考仍由人类垄断。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性、最核心的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demands broad expertise—GPU kernels to distributed systems—and demand for such engineers will grow 10–100x despite AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程需要从 GPU 内核到分布式系统的广泛专长；即便有 AI 辅助编程，这类工程师的需求仍将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization is calibratable, not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 优化可分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）两类；量化可针对工作负载校准，并非天生有害。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration: disaggregated prefill/decode, KV cache management, and workload-specific systems.
philipkiely.zh: 该领域正从编写内核转向基础设施编排：分离式预填充/解码、KV 缓存管理，以及面向特定工作负载的系统。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, making kernel-level programming less central.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC 化，使内核级编程不再居于中心。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需平衡有用性与无害性；合成数据与强化学习后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此在原型开发中需用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术，需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，需要持续演进的基准；基准应是连续的而非固定的。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张服务数十亿用户的单一模型会收敛为平均声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识和多样性。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and a design.md style guide to direct models; editing references beats starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应构建自己的 AI 工具，用截图和 design.md 风格指南来指导模型；编辑参考比从零开始更有效。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: The only way to stay ahead is to spend the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries, and to refine workflows constantly.
mengto.zh: 保持领先的唯一方法是将最后 10% 的精力花在现有库中没有的独特功能上，并不断优化工作流程。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful expensive problem.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的工作，并专注于一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% complete, iterate with real feedback, and fund with high-paying clients instead of venture capital.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是恐惧；在 80% 完成时发布，根据真实反馈迭代，并用高付费客户而非风险投资来资助。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as everyone becomes a model manager, generalists and management skills gain value.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会推动就业回流与“分配经济”：当人人都成为模型管理者，通才与管理能力反而更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他主张用经济标准定义 AGI（通用人工智能）：能无限期运行智能体并盈利才算，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent, but agents need a caring human; benchmarks overestimate autonomy and oversight remains essential.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为“人人都有智能体”，但智能体需要在意它的人来管理；基准高估自主性，人类监督仍不可少。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work, plus one company-wide super agent, are the future.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他立场转向：命令行已过时，Codex、Claude Co-work 等图形工作界面和公司级超级智能体才是未来。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; even superintelligence stays tool-like, so jobs multiply rather than vanish.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：AI 只是放大人类品味与手艺的非特定放大器；即便超级智能也仍是工具，工作会增多而非消失。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, and narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights, with anti-gravity as a new through line.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重，anti-gravity 成为贯穿产品的新主线。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time, and users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是最大化客户成果而非停留时长，长尾用户仍想自己掌控方向。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; they can't capture all customers, and the pace of change creates opportunity, so founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难，它们无法捕获所有客户；变化速度带来机会，创始人不必过度担忧前沿模型公司。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, and solving software creation yields a thousand times more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解，而解决软件创造会带来千倍机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；能写代码、做设计、与用户交流的通才工程师极受重视。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架是临时技术债，不要与模型对赌。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of my code is written by Claude Code; the software engineer title will fade into 'builder' as coding democratizes.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决：我的代码 100%由 Claude Code 编写；随着编程民主化，软件工程师头衔将淡化为“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is core, not just commercial: Claude Code is a safety research tool; releasing early studies real-world behavior, and alignment research drives product development.
boris.zh: 安全是核心而非仅商业：Claude Code 是安全研究工具；尽早发布以研究真实世界行为，对齐研究驱动产品开发。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction after agents; give models tools and let them self-verify; delete most system prompts and rebuild through ablation experiments.
boris.zh: 循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；给模型工具并让其自我验证；删除大部分系统提示并通过消融实验重建。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents turn engineers from bricklayers into architects; base intelligence suffices, so the hard part is human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体把工程师从砌砖工变成建筑师；基础智能已够用，真正的难点是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI raises demand for software and programmers; Devin works as a junior engineer under human oversight, not a replacement.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论论证 AI 会扩大软件与程序员需求；Devin 更像接受人类监督的初级工程师，而非替代者。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; enterprise agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进改进；企业采用智能体靠信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be judged by outcomes, not tokens, and the token-max era ended.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他称编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，“token 最大化”时代已结束。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is near and AI will solve intelligence long term, yet the singularity is not imminent and capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他判断丰裕时代临近、AI 长期将解决智能问题，但奇点并不迫近，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升让更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，工具趋向轻量、通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not merely preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年他强调，对齐不只是防止伤害，更通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward more open-ended, end-to-end agents, with model taste built through hands-on prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体，模型品味靠亲手实验与原型打磨。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, while evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张，安全与对齐让 Claude 因敢于反驳而更有用；最大化 token 投入是活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline with programmable cells.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学变成可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling（规模扩张）remains the bottleneck.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，Scaling 仍是瓶颈。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近 100% 疗效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal via partial reprogramming needs engineering plus AI to handle complexity.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度；通过部分重编程逆转衰老需要工程手段加 AI 来应对复杂性。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, and is arriving just in time to offset aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难，而且来得正是时候，可对冲人口老龄化与劳动力萎缩。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy is urgently needed where labor is short.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、矿业和建筑业，而不只是汽车；在劳动力短缺的领域，自主化需求迫切。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest problem is not algorithms but data collection, safety validation, and slow diffusion into existing machines over many years.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是算法，而是数据采集、安全验证，以及用多年时间缓慢渗透进现有机器。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models will scale better than imitation learning or physics-based simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习与神经世界模型，会比模仿学习或基于物理的仿真更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: A horizontal platform beats vertical integration; Tesla's end-to-end cost advantage will win over Waymo's overbuilt approach.
qasaryounis.zh: 横向平台优于垂直整合；特斯拉端到端的成本优势将胜过 Waymo 过度工程化的路线。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; other domains face validation and data challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是前沿模型目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；其他领域则面临验证和数据的挑战。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化，且没有网络效应；价值向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: The chatbot is a limited V1 UI; mass adoption needs wrapped apps, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面；大规模采用需要封装好的应用，而当前使用仍然很浅。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions, so job predictions are futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会以难以预测的方式创造新岗位；AI 改变的是任务而非消灭职业，因此预测哪些工作会被取代是徒劳的。

clairevo.en: Agents should be scoped like employees with clear roles, access, and progressive trust; start with one agent, then specialize.
clairevo.zh: 智能体应像员工一样被界定角色、权限与渐进式信任；先从一个智能体起步，再逐步专业化分工。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills; being polite to agents improves outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 角色界定与上手引导等管理能力比技术能力更重要；对智能体保持礼貌也能改善结果。

clairevo.en: Agent bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit, not failure; open-source decomposability beats closed alternatives for learning.
clairevo.zh: 智能体的缺陷与粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号而非失败；开源的可拆解性在学习上优于闭源方案。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating agents as a team, while humans retain accountability for AI output.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过像团队一样编排智能体来构建正经业务，但人类仍须对 AI 产出负责。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not technology; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正护城河而非技术；大模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，新颖想法须由人类提供。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags behind breadth and contextuality, and scaling laws face diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理引擎；可靠性落后于广度和上下文能力，缩放定律面临收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-hoc checks are insufficient—reliability must be architected in.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚和欺骗；事后检查不够——可靠性必须内建于架构中。

danklein.en: LLM mistakes lack 'smells'—they are confident and fluent whether right or wrong; core LLMs lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know.
danklein.zh: LLM 的错误没有“气味”——无论对错都自信流畅；核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: The web is a one-time data source; there is no second internet of higher knowledge, so new techniques like reasoning and search are needed beyond scaling.
danklein.zh: 网络是一次性数据源；不存在更高知识的第二个互联网，因此除了 Scaling（规模扩张）还需要推理和搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, as rapid model improvements make long-term roadmaps obsolete; product taste becomes the top skill.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，PM 的规划周期应从数年缩短到一个月，产品品味成为最核心的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, shifting the engineering role.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，转而聚焦产品品味与商业判断，工程角色随之转变。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaces hard rules.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再依赖大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，由模型判断取代硬规则。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now viable: a codebase is a spec, and a good test suite makes rewriting safe rather than risky.
catwu.zh: 重写代码如今可行：代码库即规格，良好的测试套件让重写变得安全而非冒险。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的内部留存与打磨标准，为每个功能在公开发布前把关。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年他指出，模型实用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应内化进权重，而非仅靠检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less beats scaling compute alone for long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 同年他强调效率与智能不可分割，以更少资源做更多事胜过单纯堆算力，才能应对长程任务。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via training-based compression.
danbiderman.zh: 他主张把预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力，通过基于训练的压缩迁移到企业知识上。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; parameter-efficient fine-tuning like LoRA can represent knowledge better than RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 他指出上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”，LoRA 等参数高效微调在整体性查询上比 RAG 更能表征知识。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized on-device models, not one giant frontier model; users own and nurture their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 他反共识地认为未来是众多设备端个性化模型而非单一巨型前沿模型，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; top-down conviction and transparency drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；自上而下的信念与透明驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws alone won't yield common-sense world models.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律无法产生具备常识的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic: it commoditizes complements and accelerates collective progress.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略举措：它使互补品商品化，并加速集体进步。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses, enabling a post-phone future where AI orchestrates services beyond apps.
bosworth.zh: 智能眼镜进化为 AI 眼镜，开启后手机时代，AI 将编排超越应用的服务。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL matters more than predicted, but most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；强化学习比预期更重要，但大多数工作并不需要前沿智能。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data and compute; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据与算力驱动，自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction yields world understanding; scaling must target the right thing, and alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他深化为：下一个词预测能带来世界理解；Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象，而超级智能的对齐极为困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas and continual learning matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他转向：预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代，想法与持续学习比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全超级智能需要无商业产品的公司。

ilya.en: A consistent 主线: neural networks learn compressed world knowledge, and safety must grow with capability and opacity.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络学习压缩的世界知识，而安全必须随能力与不透明性同步增长。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting out time; long-term thinking and first principles are foundational.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富需要拥有股权而非出租时间，长期思考和第一性原理是基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 至关重要。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; we can't even align humans. Worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：对齐（alignment）是个笑话，我们连人类都无法对齐；应担心人类滥用 AI，而非 AI 本身不对齐。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy. Wealth, health, and peace come from within.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是不快乐的契约；财富、健康与平静源于内心。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天 1% 的改进可复利成每年 3700% 的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位会消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具与设备的编排最重要。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real value, and companies should be built with far fewer people.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架创造真正价值，公司应以远更少的人构建。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs, but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是新瓶颈，团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 他观察到角色在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 他反思 Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的家园，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead and pre-training remains a muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练仍是需要重建的关键肌肉。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in a year.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键，这一担忧从 2025 延续到 2026。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency, so education must teach verification skills.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；因此教育应从作业转向项目式评估并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域出色，却在创意写作等主观领域受挫。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis as benchmarks saturate; eval teams should be separate from model builders to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 评测正陷入危机、经典基准已饱和；评测团队应与模型构建团队分离，以防作弊。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型才是真正理解世界的关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他进一步指出，单纯扩大深度或参数量无法解决根本的表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理和解耦表征，并认为短期 AI 安全风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 作为可学习的采样方法，强调多样性采样和抽象因果结构对分布外泛化的重要性；并认为意识可能是注意力机制和世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I changed my mind: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI systems already show self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他公开表示改变想法：ChatGPT 之后意识到危险路径，即使 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 系统已表现出自我保存、欺骗和谄媚等对齐问题。

bengio.en: We need Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI 方案：训练非智能体式的诚实预测器，通过数学保证安全，避免对超级智能使用强化学习；同时强调国际协调和权力集中风险。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，架构已不再关键，AGI 将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety shifts from scaling alone to explicit training and layered defenses; jailbreaking is a fundamental flaw.
kolter.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他的安全观从单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）转向显式训练与多层防御，并把越狱视为根本性缺陷。

kolter.en: Bigger models are not safer; capability does not correlate with robustness; automated red teaming beats humans.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他明确大模型并不更安全，能力与鲁棒性不相关，自动化红队已能超越人类红队。

kolter.en: Agents bring prompt-injection and permission risks; interpretability may succeed via AI agents doing research.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体带来提示注入与权限风险，而可解释性可能借 AI 智能体做自动化研究而真正成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; future biology AI needs new curated datasets like the PDB.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；未来生物学 AI 需要像 PDB 一样的新精选数据集。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture handles diverse biomolecules; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构处理多样生物分子；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key; equivariance is overhyped.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键；等变性被过度炒作。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非细胞模型；它提供预测与控制，理解留给人类。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于面对面的沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室需要现实的时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so processes must be rewritten and old ones killed.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是，因此必须重写流程并砍掉旧流程。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time, design docs replaced by PRs, and technical debates settled by generating multiple AI-assisted PRs.
fiona.zh: 规划应即时进行，设计文档被 PR 取代，技术争论应通过生成多个 AI 辅助的 PR 来解决。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, build street cred, and stay hands-on with the pulse.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮、建立信誉，并保持亲力亲为以把握产品脉搏。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and apprenticeship models become essential as roles blur.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；随着角色模糊，高能动性配高问责、验证框架和学徒模式变得至关重要。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence that data cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 设计要满足人们说不出口的情感需求；直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and teacher.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非取代人性、融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师与老师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, not decoration.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受、后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而非装饰。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; designers must speak business language and prove ideas through results.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合；设计师要会说商业语言，并用结果证明想法。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space, not pixels, are the next paradigm.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，在抽象表示空间而非像素预测的世界模型才是下一范式。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and open research is essential for progress.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI 是误导性术语，开放研究对进步至关重要。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, not complexity, with values inserted via RLHF.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型讲得很朴素：本质是确定性的下一个词预测，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计，价值观则由 RLHF 注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products like AI DJ need fault-tolerant UI matched to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 同年他从产品侧判断：互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，AI DJ 这类生成式产品必须用容错界面去匹配算法能力。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; inference cost will force business-model change, though near-term impact on big firms is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他持续强调生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话；到 2025 年他进一步指出推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，但大公司当下的实际收益被高估。

gustav.en: Companies must reposition to surf the AI macro shift; Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观浪潮，主张公司重新定位去冲浪，并通过 API 与 MCP 开放数据，让非开发者也能用上 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; 'time well spent' over engagement, with first adoption key amid change.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为反参与度：AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，坚持“时间花得值”，并在技术变革期抢先采用。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public with continuous iterative deployment and public feedback to improve alignment.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须公开进行，通过持续迭代部署和公众反馈来改进对齐。

murati.en: From real-world deployment to interaction models enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based.
murati.zh: 从真实世界部署转向交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires long-term focus over compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要长期专注而非压缩的波动。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound reasoning and reliable AI.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向超级智能；形式化验证对于可靠推理和可信 AI 不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Verified generation boosts performance and sample efficiency, reframing formal verification as scaling brilliance rather than just error elimination.
carinahong.zh: 验证式生成能提升性能与样本效率，将形式化验证重新定义为扩展卓越能力，而不仅仅是消除错误。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman provers.
carinahong.zh: 由于缺乏 grounding，自动形式化比证明更难；即使证明器超越人类，人类的品味与直觉仍至关重要。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is key for reliable coding and mathematical discovery, from conjecture to proof.
carinahong.zh: 将非形式化推理与形式化验证相结合，是可靠编码与数学发现（从猜想 to 证明）的关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal methods enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化方法能促进超越安全关键领域的开放协作。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; recent gains come mainly from post-training RL, synthetic data, and chain of thought, not from scaling up alone.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立；近期收益主要来自后训练中的强化学习、合成数据与思维链，而非单纯堆规模。

kaiser.en: The slowdown narrative is wrong: progress is a smooth exponential, but distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 放缓叙事是错的：进展是平滑的指数曲线；拖慢预训练 Scaling 的是蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent nearby, poor nearby—so generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域极强、邻近领域却很弱；因此核心挑战仍是泛化，单靠推理不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题，却需要海量数据；与人类不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x parallel productivity; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research, while open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: Codex 类编程智能体带来 5-10 倍的并行生产力；硬件进步让单卡研究普及，开源则因主权需求持续存在。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 才是关键，而非一味做大模型；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; data quality is a bottleneck alongside compute; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调效率提升三年可达百倍，数据质量与算力同为瓶颈；价值将沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; jobs augmented, not replaced.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向积极拥抱 AI，主张主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观；AI 增强而非取代工作，需人在回路。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents; AGI as single system will never exist; pre-training saturates.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty is strategic for every state; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权对每个国家都是战略必需；AGI 是方向而非终点，重在实际整合。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the main lever trading latency against cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的主要杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference hits a memory wall, so context length stagnates; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost with quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文推理撞上内存墙，上下文窗口因此停滞；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本但受质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, now drives design.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为如今驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Inside AI chips, data movement dominates compute cost; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory cut that overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 在 AI 芯片内部，数据搬运主导计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存可削减这一开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8 throughput.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：位宽的二阶缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；预训练上的 Scaling（规模扩张）已显现收益递减。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; inference-time compute is a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为；推理时算力是一条新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they just demand exponentially more compute, pressuring algorithmic innovation; long context windows give working memory but too much info confuses models.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是同等提升需要指数级更多算力，从而倒逼算法创新；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会让模型混乱。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像领域的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; post-training and RL remain a green field beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；后训练与强化学习在编程、数学之外仍是广阔蓝海。

jonyive.en: Design's next frontier is intimate wearables, while in-person presence remains irreplaceable for fragile creative ideas.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计的下一前沿是更私密的可穿戴设备，甚至终将隐入皮下；同时强调虚拟沟通无法替代面对面，因为最有力的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要悉心呵护。

jonyive.en: A consistent thread: curiosity and care must be intentional, protecting fragile ideas from status quo and profit-driven design.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 一以贯之的主线：好奇心与关怀需要刻意坚持，要保护脆弱想法不被现状与利润驱动所吞没。

jonyive.en: Design should express values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity carries joy and humanity rather than soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他深化为：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁带有喜悦与人性，而非没有灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other out of care and gratitude is more powerful than merely making things people want.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他提出，出于关怀与感恩为彼此造物，比单纯制造人们想要的东西更有力量；用户是成熟的，能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Innovation means redefining the brand, not electrifying an existing model; authenticity forbids fake engine sounds and touchscreen mimicry.
jonyive.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计观延伸到汽车：创新是重新定义品牌而非给现有车型通电；真实性拒绝伪造引擎声与触屏模仿，并主张以物理按键保障安全。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；通过蒸馏，认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; we're in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；我们处于智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is terrible and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据缺乏熵会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; delegate to agents. Vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the quality bar.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我没写过代码，全委托给智能体；氛围编程提高下限，智能体式工程保持专业质量。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on product knowledge beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出,优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发;建立在产品认知上的直觉,比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must adapt and customize process per project rather than trust it.
jennywen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年,他明确宣告传统的调研—发散—收敛流程已死;设计师应按每个项目定制流程,而不是信任流程本身。

jennywen.en: Mockup time fell from 60-70% to 30-40%; designers now help engineers execute and ship early to build trust through speed.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他指出,画稿时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%;设计师转而帮工程师落地执行,靠快速交付与迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; north stars shorten even at cutting-edge companies.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他把设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月;即便前沿公司,北极星目标也随之缩短。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and sitting with ambiguity matter, while AI improves at taste but humans decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场:仅靠品味救不了设计师,判断力、权威与容纳模糊性才是关键;AI 会提升品味,但由人决定什么重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning can close it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他把「泛化」视为智能的核心缺口：主张用无目标的好奇心驱动探索配合高样本效率的强化学习来弥合，并批评依赖稠密奖励的强化学习不现实。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move past quasi-static tasks; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies enable dynamic motion and zero-shot generalization across morphologies.
pathak.zh: 同年他强调机器人学习要摆脱准静态任务，用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略实现动态动作，并跨形态零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Data, not algorithms, is the binding constraint: no internet of robot data, so diverse pretraining plus real-world post-training and a data flywheel are essential.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线从算法泛化转向数据瓶颈：没有机器人数据的互联网，只能靠多样预训练加真实数据后训练，并以数据飞轮扩张。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any form factor; scaling recipe is pretraining on video and simulation, then post-training on real data.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他提出通用机器人「大脑」：像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样跨形态跨任务，配方是先在海量视频与仿真上预训练，再用真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment, not software-style scaling, is the primary challenge; robotics cannot succeed overnight and needs rigorous testing, with home-robot timelines highly uncertain.
pathak.zh: 他明确转向：部署本身是技术难题而非单纯商业问题，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，家用机器人时间表高度不确定——这与早年对泛化突破的乐观形成对照。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习；模型福祉塑造着人机关系。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; models need a core identity with good traits yet adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；模型需要具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其成为独特的、带有孩童般特质的实体。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要减少显式指导、留出更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability, and respect for possibly conscious models avoids future resentment.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明对问责至关重要，而尊重可能具有意识的模型可避免未来的怨恨。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment risks grow.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时 对齐 风险随之上升。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag, and the term AGI is losing meaning.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，并指出能力评测正成为瓶颈、基准滞后，AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; RL alone is insufficient and dedicated continual-learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把持续学习定为核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练 与 强化学习 实现；单靠 强化学习 不够，专设持续学习实验室是误判。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为 思维链 监控是关键 对齐 工具，产品中隐藏 思维链 才能保住其 可解释性 价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision paradigms and raising power-concentration risk.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出长期 对齐 的核心是超出训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数日，需要新的监督范式，最大社会风险是权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需等待新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is no longer a blocker; hybrid rule-based plus learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续反驳“端到端不可解释”的旧观念，认为现代工具已可解释，而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this lesson on prioritizing infrastructure came late.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心明确转向基础设施与数据质量，坦言“基础设施优先于算法”是较晚才学到的教训，深化了早期对数据效率的强调。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable; consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步给出可验证的泛化主张：无需先验数据即可跨 500 多座城市零样本泛化，并判断带内置传感器的量产车在中短期内将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third option, so the trolley problem is theoretical; language integration aids representation and reasoning.
kendall.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全至上——最小风险操作总能提供“第三种选择”，电车难题只是理论练习；同时语言集成持续提升表征、推理与交互能力。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步真正的瓶颈，而非基准测试或排行榜。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他提出：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务超越下一个词预测。

edwinchen.en: LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new learning paradigms are needed, and AGI is a decade or more away.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他持续认为：仅靠 LLM 或许无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能），需要新的学习范式，AGI 还要十年以上。

edwinchen.en: As models confabulate, human judgment and safety-first deployment matter more than raw accuracy, especially in medicine.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向应用场景：模型会虚构，人类判断与安全优先的部署比单纯准确率更重要，医疗领域尤甚。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有唯一模型通吃，每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship fast to learn, and chat is just an early interface like MS-DOS, not the end.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；快速发布以学习，聊天只是像 MS-DOS 一样的早期界面，并非终点。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

turley.en: AI should amplify human capability, keeping users in the driver's seat; curiosity is the key skill in the AI era.
turley.zh: AI 应放大人类能力，让用户掌控方向；好奇心是 AI 时代的关键技能。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, prove themselves with simpler products, and build brand by uniting teams on a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司必须先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并通过更高目标团结团队来建设品牌。

carlpei.en: AI is the future of phones: agentic software and generative UI will replace app-based interaction, but most AI is BS and models will commoditize.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是手机的未来：智能体式软件和生成式 UI 将取代基于应用的交互，但大多数 AI 是废话，模型将商品化。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, using design and content as key differentiators.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化了硬件难做且利润低的认知，认为 Nothing 必须超越硬件，以设计和内容作为关键差异化优势。

carlpei.en: AI should be an invisible ingredient for utility, not a marketing hype; focus on solving user pain points elegantly.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AI 应作为提升实用性的隐形配料，而非营销噱头；应专注于优雅地解决用户痛点。

carlpei.en: Design, brand, and community are consistent differentiators; challengers must find marketing arbitrage and stay optimistic.
carlpei.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：设计、品牌和社区是持续的差异化因素；挑战者必须找到营销套利并保持乐观。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可绕开昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体；机器人应像人一样学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and research must embrace failure.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，研究必须拥抱失败、简化问题。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest open challenges; we do not yet have solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署视为当下最大的开放挑战，并坦言尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it can leapfrog legacy gaps, with language models revolutionizing local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而能跨越历史包袱；语言模型可革新非洲本地语言教育。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need embodied experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要具身经验，而不仅是更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most work, with RL for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作；RL 负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: The data bottleneck in robotics is solved by synthetic data from simulation and world models, enabling scalable robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：机器人领域的数据瓶颈要靠仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据解决，从而实现可扩展的机器人学习。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试（机器人清理脏乱房间）是重大挑战。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式；追求投入产出比，而非把每个界面都做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection: ship fast, iterate, and empower designers with ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地认为速度与决断胜过完美：快速发布、持续迭代，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just decorate.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，而不只是装饰。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是一个品牌而非一家公司，因此要尽早投资品牌。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt; maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还；通过快速、粗糙的实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s design tools are legacy and AI enables genuine forward progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，以代码为真相源；90 年代的设计工具已是遗产，AI 带来真正的进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补差距的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling 轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bottleneck, not just capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（以时间跨度上的成功率衡量）才是真正瓶颈，而不仅是能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为编程是领先指标和最易处理的领域，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter more; future work is managing fleets of AI agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩意味着编排和算力更重要，未来工作是管理智能体集群。

truell.en: Scaling laws make AI progress predictable; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他相信缩放定律让 AI 进步可预测，并预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models went from a product detail to essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，定制模型从产品细节变成必需品——如今 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开它，为的是速度和成本。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift will outstrip the internet and unfold over decades; the IDE market is far larger because AI enables more value creation.
truell.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定性为超越互联网、需数十年展开的转变，并认为 AI 创造更多价值使 IDE 市场远大于以往。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；同时质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决常识，认为下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Smaller models with better inference-time algorithms and filtered synthetic data can match larger ones; language remains the best medium for reasoning.
yejin.zh: 同年她主张更小的模型配合更好的推理算法与经过筛选的合成数据，可在特定任务上追平大模型；并坚持语言是承载推理与常识的最佳媒介。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈，指出当前方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此 AI 需要探索未知知识，并强调可证伪性比提出假设更关键。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and open research is essential against closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她深化对强化学习的审慎态度：RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时损害 pass@k，随机或错误奖励也能带来改进；并呼吁开放研究以对抗封闭的前沿模型实验室。

yejin.en: Small language models plus diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models, which show unexpected homogeneity; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步主张小模型配合多样化合成数据与多元对齐可媲美前沿模型，并指出后者存在意外的同质化；把强化学习用作预训练目标虽昂贵，却带来持久的推理提升。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though what happens inside remains opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型的核心归结为下一个词预测这一 AI-complete 问题，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）投入更多算力和数据就能让 AI 更聪明，同时坦言网络内部机制仍像炼金术一样不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers and brand-risk caution can hinder development.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用、最好的应用往往出乎创造者预料，并持续批评产品经理与品牌风险顾虑拖慢开发。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need far longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他把推理侧算力扩张视为近期最大机会，主张模型需要处理长达万亿级 token 的上下文窗口，并用混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining, and AI-driven productivity could lift world GDP by orders of magnitude.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他进一步主张模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，用可独立训练的模块做持续学习以取代单体式重训，并认为 AI 带来的生产力提升可能让全球 GDP 增长数个数量级。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive reasoning progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年 3 月，他判断测试时算力扩张与强化学习能推动推理进步但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力至关重要，并认为 AGI 的经济影响被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他指出机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；同时自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移至图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，机会众多。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展；我们需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；需要第三方测试和监管。
